summary: Zhibao Technology filed a 6-K reporting a September 17, 2026 amendment to its senior secured convertible note SPA and waivers supporting a third closing. The issuer sold a $1,000,000 principal Third Note for $900,000 (10% OID) to an existing noteholder, following prior $3,333,333 and $555,556 notes. Terms remove any conversion floor, cap shares at 35,941,170, require 125% payoff if the cap is reached, and mandate 12 equal monthly installments. No board recommendation or advisor is named. Watch dilution, share-cap trigger and repayment liquidity risk.
